descriptions.NAME: About Usecode C
TEXT: Usecode C is a scripting language created by the Exult  team which can be compiled to usecode. It allows the creation of usecode patches for the Ultima VII games, thus allowing changes to the behavior of objects, the addition of new dialogs and new cutscenes.

descriptions.NAME: About the Usecode C tutorials
TEXT: The Usecode C tutorials in this page are meant to help new usecoders to make sense of Usecode C. They are meant to be a complete introduction to the language. They most liikely are not, and I welcome any suggestions on how to improve them.
I also intend to place these documents in the Exult  source code and documentation; if they are not there yet, I am getting there soon (although complaining might prove effective :-).

descriptions.NAME: About the Usecode C reference
TEXT: This section is intended to provide extensive documentation about the Usecode C language. It is meant to be throughout, and it can be quite dry at places. These documents are not meant for the newbie, although they will surely help.
I also intend to place these documents in the Exult  source code and documentation; if they are not there yet, I am getting there soon (although complaining might prove effective :-).

descriptions.NAME: Exult Usecode Syntax for Visual Studio Code
TEXT: Exult Usecode Syntax provides syntax highlighting for Usecode C, extracted usecode, and usecode assembly in Visual Studio Code. Browse the extension on the Visual Studio Marketplace, open it in VS Code to install it, or visit its source repository on GitHub.

notice.TITLE: Important Notice
TEXT: In order to be able to use new usecode in the Ultima VII games, you must first compile the usecode using the Usecode C Compiler (ucc). You can obtain a Windows binary of the compiler in the following link: Exult Win32 Tools snapshot . If you wisely don't use Windows, you will have to compile your own binary.
